Therapeutic support tailored to your life right now

I work with adults navigating anxiety, trauma, relationship shifts, and career or parenting transitions. Together we clarify what matters and develop steady ways forward.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

Sessions offered in-person in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} and by telehealth. Confidentiality and limits to confidentiality are explained before we begin.

People say the process feels grounded and practical

Licensed clinician: {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, {{LICENSE}}. Not a substitute for emergency care. If you are in crisis, call 911 or your local emergency number.

What people gain from working together

  • Practical skills

    Concrete strategies for regulating overwhelm and managing symptoms day-to-day.

  • Clearer decisions

    Space to examine values and weigh options during transitions without pressure.

  • Healthier connections

    Build communication and boundary skills that feel authentic rather than rehearsed.

How we typically work together

  1. Intake & assessment

    We begin with an intake to understand your history, current struggles, and goals. We review confidentiality and informed consent.

  2. Short-term planning

    Together we make a focused plan—skills to try, patterns to notice, and how we’ll measure progress.

  3. Ongoing work

    Sessions are collaborative: we learn what helps, adjust pace, and address life events as they arise.

  4. Review & transition

    When goals are met or circumstances shift, we review progress and plan next steps or referrals as needed.

Free guide: Calming strategies you can try today

Short, practical exercises to reduce intensity in the moment and build steady habits over weeks.

About me

I’m {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, a clinician offering cognitive-behavioral and trauma-informed approaches. I work with adults on anxiety, trauma recovery, relationship patterns, burnout, and life transitions. Modalities: {{MODALITIES}}.

Learn more about my background

Questions people often ask

What should I expect in the first 2–3 sessions?
The first sessions focus on building rapport, clarifying concerns, and collaborating on immediate steps you can try. We also cover practical matters like scheduling, payment, and confidentiality.
Do you accept insurance?
I am a private-pay clinician and provide superbills for insurance reimbursement when possible. I can help you understand options during the intake.
How long are sessions and how often should I come?
Standard sessions are 50 minutes. Frequency is individualized—many people begin weekly and later reduce to biweekly as skills take hold.

Ready to start?

Schedule a 15-minute consultation to see if we’re a good fit.

Book a consult Or ask a question: {{EMAIL}}
